meta.title: Service PO: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role, attempt to raise a Service PO, then repeat as a Buyer in the same tenant and compare whether the action is refused or available.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role, attempt to raise a Service PO, then repeat as a Buyer in the same tenant and compare whether the action is refused or available.
